slides.text: Koti bus stop. July. Thunder, and the kind of rain that doesn't stop.
A stranger tilted his umbrella toward her. Twenty minutes. Not a single word.
Her bus came. She got on. The umbrella stayed with him. He never asked her name.
Every monsoon after that, he went back to the same bus stop. Just in case.
Seventh year. A woman stood beside him, holding an umbrella. "It took me seven years to return this."
The Secret to Love That Lasts
